body_markdown:
On the episode released on October 8, 2024, ZoomInfo’s Chief Technology Officer, **Ali Dasdan** , joined *Dissemniate* podcast, hosted by Dr. Jack Waudby.
In this podcast, Ali dives into wide array of topics, ranging from technology innovation to productivity and leadership.
We encourage you to[tune in](https://shows.acast.com/629a6154b4e1e70012764c00/670395d36f369dd0359ff627) to this captivating discussion and the great insights Ali shares.
